hints: football pitch, players in two kits, a score bug with two team codes, a score and a match clock

facts.home_team_name: full name of the home team (the first team shown)
facts.away_team_name: full name of the away team
facts.competition: competition and round, e.g. 'UEFA Champions League, league phase'
facts.home_lineup: list of the home starting XI player names
facts.away_lineup: list of the away starting XI player names
facts.standings: the current table of this competition (for a league phase or group: that table), as a list of {rank, team, played, won, drawn, lost, goals_for, goals_against, points}: the top 8 rows plus the rows of both teams of this match
